sentences.l2: 在不少大城市，一套老房子的价格往往远超它的居住价值，原因只有一个：它是学区房。
sentences.l1: In quite a few big cities, the price of an old apartment often far exceeds its value as a place to live, for only one reason: it is a school-district home.

sentences.l2: 所谓学区房，指的是与优质对口学校划在同一片区的住宅。
sentences.l1: A so-called school-district home refers to a residence zoned in the same district as a good designated school.

sentences.l2: 家长相信，只要买下这里，孩子便能顺利入学，避开残酷的择校竞争。
sentences.l1: Parents believe that as long as they buy here, their child will be able to enroll smoothly and avoid the cruel competition of choosing a school.

sentences.l2: 于是，交易市场上出现了耐人寻味的一幕：房子越小、越旧，单价反而越高。
sentences.l1: So a thought-provoking scene appears in the trading market: the smaller and older the apartment, the higher the unit price instead.

sentences.l2: 许多家庭倾尽积蓄，甚至卖掉宽敞的新居，只为换一间几十平方米的老屋，还要费尽周折把户口迁入。
sentences.l1: Many families spend all their savings, and even sell their spacious new homes, just to exchange them for an old place of a few dozen square meters, and they must also go to great trouble to move their household registration in.

sentences.l2: 为了一个学位名额，同一套房子里可能挤进好几户人家的户口。
sentences.l1: For a single school place, the household registrations of several families may be crammed into the same apartment.

sentences.l2: 然而，这份焦虑正被政策慢慢稀释。
sentences.l1: However, this anxiety is being slowly diluted by policy.

sentences.l2: 多校划片、教师轮岗等举措陆续推行，对口学校不再意味着稳操胜券。
sentences.l1: Measures such as multi-school zoning and teacher rotation have been introduced one after another, and a designated school no longer means a sure win.

sentences.l2: 有专家提醒，当学区房的光环褪去，房价或将回落，届时为它付出的代价，恐怕难以收回。
sentences.l1: Some experts warn that when the halo of school-district homes fades, housing prices may fall, and by then the price paid for them will probably be hard to recover.
